WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_count) AS avg_count
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT 
  AVG(rc.rental_count) AS avg_count_above_average,
  AVG(rc.rental_count - oa.avg_count) AS avg_excess
FROM rating_counts rc
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE rc.rental_count > oa.avg_count
